text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(The upcoming academy fan appreciation 
event... It is an ideal opportunity to 
test my progress.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(Movement that transcends limits, like 
that ballet dancer— Can I truly reach that 
realm?)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(To transcend limits. For that purpose, I 
must enlist her strength...!)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I wish to perform a show alongside you 
that tests our limits. And through it, 
arrive at new heights—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna-san. Will you do me the honor 
of being my partner?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: A partner, is it?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Then demonstrate it for me. Show me just 
how magnificent a partner you can truly 
be.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Very well, I shall prove it. Through my 
performance!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —Here I go.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(—I must not tense up. Yet... I must 
remain perpetually conscious of the 
kinetic chain.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(Just as Fuji-san and Marvelous-san taught 
me, relax both mind and body...)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(Like the dancer I saw that day, supple 
and expansive—)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Lukewarm.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Gentildonna-san...?!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You are still braking with your intellect. 
That is why your movement is constrained.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—You have not broken past your limits. Am 
I mistaken?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(More... even more! Even if it is mere 
imitation, I must match Gentildonna-san's 
movements—)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(I have no choice but to give it 
everything!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: More!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (Larger, faster! Bolder—!)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: My physical form— is not limited to this!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Splendid! Now, what is next?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: *Pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I commend your desperate tenacity.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: However. It is still insufficient.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Nevertheless—if you possess the spirit to 
strive for greater heights, I shall 
instruct you in practice.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
So that when you stand beside me, you will 
not be overshadowed, and can deliver a 
performance worthy of the stage. —So that 
you may shatter your limits.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! I look forward to working with 
you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the fan event— The show 
performance concluded in grand success, 
drawing to a close amid relentless cheers 
and applause.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I was blown away! I had no idea a body 
could move like that...! Seriously, I 
couldn't take my eyes off her the entire 
time!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Flash's sheer beauty... it really moved 
me...! It was so gorgeous that it almost 
brought tears to my eyes...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Truly... my heart is so very 
full.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I feel that I too have finally attained 
it. Just like that ballet dancer I admired 
on that day—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The 'physical beauty' that lies beyond 
common sense, surpassing all limits.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Does that mean you are already 
satisfied?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No. Because I still have my next 
objective.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I will demonstrate it on the 
racetrack. A performance that transcends 
all boundaries, for everyone to see.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Transcend limits, continuously evolve, and 
seize victory on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
With this body—one capable of turning the 
impossible into the possible—I shall 
without fail make my dream a reality.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Through this experience, I have 
gained absolute confidence that my plan 
was correct.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I will execute the perfect schedule and 
deliver flawless results. Without fail.
